capabilities: Edit .qmd files in Obsidian's standard Markdown editor
Run live Quarto preview in-app or in an external browser
Render .qmd files to PDF, DOCX, HTML, or reveal.js via quarto render
Create new .qmd files from built-in or vault templates
Show a sidebar outline of the active .qmd file's headings
disambiguation: Not an exporter that converts Obsidian Markdown notes into .qmd files; it edits and renders .qmd files in place.
extras: Desktop only (Quarto runs as an external process); requires Obsidian 1.8.0+. Beta releases are distributed only via BRAT, the community store tracks the latest stable release (currently 0.3.0). Includes a CSS snippet for hiding Quarto project clutter and a pandoc Lua filter bridging Obsidian callouts to Quarto callouts (Quarto >= 1.3).
intentEvidence: this plugin allows you to compile QMD files as they are, without exporting them to another folder
problem: Obsidian's editor and core panels do not handle .qmd files, so Quarto documents cannot be edited, outlined, previewed, or rendered without leaving the vault or exporting them elsewhere.

relations.evidence: This plugin shells out to the quarto CLI for all preview and render operations
originated in 2022 as a minimal change to a now-archived project by deathau
